Application Description

Simply dial with WhatCall and the person you dial will receive an instant missed call from your number, while you are directed straight to their voicemail without ringing and any possibility of them answering your call. WhatCall helps you avoid returning or making a call when you don't really want to speak to someone, but gives you the excuse and proof that you tried! With WhatCall they'll even receive a missed call text message from their network if it supports that feature! WhatCall works in every country and on most networks that have a voicemail including landline and mobile. It automatically figures out all the dialling codes so you can go ahead and dial in the same local format you use on your iPhone (See screenshot examples for US, UK and Japan). Examples of where WhatCall is useful: - Calling in sick to work but don't want to speak to your boss and answer lots of awkward questions. With WhatCall your boss with think you tried calling them while you can leave a voicemail letting them know you won't be in to work. - Returning a call to a friend or partner when you're busy and don't have time to speak to them. WhatCall will connect you straight to voicemail allowing you to leave a message without spending precious time getting drawn into a conversation. - Leaving a message for someone you know is unable to answer the phone (eg. in a meeting or putting a baby to sleep) but may have forgotten to turn off their phone. WhatCall will direct your phone calls to their voicemail without ringing and disturbing them. - Leaving an important message for someone when you don't have time for a full conversation or to type out a long SMS message, use WhatCall and dial direct to voicemail instead.

Application Description

Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere. TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO • Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards • Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers • One roster — switch freely; progress, items and wallet are shared FIVE CLASSES • Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive • Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power • Witcher — swift blood-clan marksman with precision shots and paralyzing arrows • Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows • Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks A CONTINENT TO CONQUER Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner. DUNGEONS & BOSSES Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns. THREE RISK MODES • Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning • Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP • Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP LIFE SKILLS & GEAR Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power. TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear. DAILY REWARDS Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding. NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia. The same account works on iOS and Android — progress is never lost. Premium game: pay once, no ads. Optional in-app purchases (diamonds, membership) available.

entry.title: Digline: Cozy Mining
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$2.99 → $0.99 [$0.99 ~ $3.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$0.99

Application Description

Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground. Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out. Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing. Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs: • Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency • Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement • Optimize routes to maximize each descent Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all. Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below. Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun! What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history. Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun. Features: • intuitive one-finger portrait controls • short runs that fit easily into a minute or two • persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition • multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises • resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation • a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress • a market system for trading what you bring back • progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run • a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it • no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems • achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland. The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold. In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same. Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer. Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
